notes: Exact programme path and broadcaster host are retained; original HTTP catalogue schemes are not rewritten.
The same programme URLs are present in both regional CMS responses, with regional artwork. Kärnten artwork is selected for review.
Austro Hits has a generic catalogue label; selecting Kärnten artwork does not assert exclusive regional identity.
Hidden secondary stream groups remain explicitly published in the broadcaster CMS; no shutdown inferred from initial page display.
Original full WebP graphics retained whole, including native backgrounds.
No catalogue URL/reference changes, production publication, audio playback or receiver test.
Radio plugin batch is independent of Vhannibal satellite artwork.

For 80er Pop, Partyhitmix and Sunrise, delivered WebP byte counts differ from CMS filesize metadata. Received images are valid 1024x1024 WebP at the exact publisher URLs; actual byte counts and SHA-256 are pinned separately. Cause of metadata discrepancy is not established.
